dedupe_keys.name: eu field boundaries from sentinel 2 2022 with crop type classification per field

description: This pair of datasets gives agricultural field boundaries across the European Union automatically delineated from Sentinel-2 imagery of May and June 2022, and a crop type for each field. The Zenodo records say the boundaries are closed vector polygons, each a homogeneous parcel with a single crop, in one GeoParquet file of about 15.5 GB, and that a Transformer deep learning model on the 2022 Sentinel-2 time series assigned one of 28 classes (for example winter wheat, grain maize, rapeseed, olive plantations, vineyards, pasture and fallow) in a CSV keyed by field identifier of about 1.5 GB. They were published in 2024 and 2025 by Matej Batič of Sinergise Solutions and co-authors, the boundaries under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence and the crop types under CC BY 4.0, free to download. Coverage is the EU for 2022. Caveats: both layers are model outputs with errors, and the crop labels are predictions, not farmer declarations. For simulation it gives field-level crop exposure across Europe for drought, flood, hail and war damage estimation. Related catalogue records include the harmonized IACS inventory and the probabilistic crop type maps for the EU.
